small_size_visual_review: 16px remains identifiable but fold seams and hooked tips lose detail. Full-detail symbol is clear at 32/64px. Recommended symbol minimum 32px and preferred 48px or more. No geometry simplification applied.
limitations: This is an editable contour reconstruction of a generated raster, not an original designer vector. The fitted circle is flat exact blue. Slight original raster irregularities are retained. Wordmark is custom outlined geometry; no named typeface claim.
